texture_justification: Reference 1-tile tree. The approved Corsican Pine atlas is 256². New models default to 128²; a larger atlas needs a justification like this one.

approved_iou.source: Closed-mask (3px) IoU of the approved Blender 4.2 export, measured 2026-11-03 by validate.py against the four TCRP direction sprites.

review.note: Approved reference model for the conifer archetype (Corsican Pine).

notes: Full tile. The 2D painter anchors a full tile at (15, 15); the model origin is the tile centre (16, 16). sprite_y_nudge -1 is that one pixel. sprite_shift [-2, 0] is the fitted correction that puts the trunk on the sprite's trunk.
